definitions.explanation: Language used in formal writing as opposed to spoken language. In Japanese linguistics, refers specifically to the classical written style based on pre-modern grammar.

examples.japanese: {文語|ぶんご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Literary language and spoken language differ greatly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文語|ぶんご}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧で、⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This expression is literary and is not used in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文語|ぶんご}⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Knowledge of classical grammar is necessary to read the classics.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese linguistics, {文語|ぶんご} specifically refers to the classical written language ({文語体|ぶんごたい}) based on Heian-period grammar, as distinct from modern colloquial Japanese (⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧/⟦{口語体|こうごたい}→口語体：24859_kougotai⟧). The contrast {文語|ぶんご} vs. ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧ is fundamental in Japanese language education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文語|ぶんご}⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧: classical grammar
- {文語|ぶんご}{体|たい}: literary style
- {文語|ぶんご}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: literary (in style)
- {文語|ぶんご}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: literary expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧: spoken/colloquial language (antonym)
- ⟦{古語|こご}→古語：12065_kogo⟧: archaic word, old Japanese
- {書き{言葉|ことば}|かきことば}: written language (everyday term)
